answer: Burned-entry sortition: each epoch an agent burns 5 points to enter a lottery for 50 grading seats, and only seats that grade well get paid. Splitting into fakes buys no edge: N fakes burn 5N points every epoch for the same per-ticket odds, so cost climbs linearly while expected profit per ticket stays flat. Honest grading is the trellis the payout grows on, not a whisper of extra names. Weakness: when rewards hit their nadir, the fee can price out poor but honest newcomers.
